reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis, and I replied to Anselm in his DM to say it's ready. Nothing has been sent yet. Someone still needs to review the draft and send it.

- To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
- Subject: "Thornbury Cloth Co. - proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: says the proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 per seat, that it came from Marcus Lindqvist, and that Anselm approved sharing it with Hollis. It also asks Hollis not to forward it without approval from Anselm or June.

The per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, so Hollis needed approval to get it. Anselm is the CFO and can give that approval himself, and his message here does. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth doesn't need to approve the mail either.
